answer: The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, forfeited on duplicate submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. By the yarrow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The zephyr lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the zenith is where a second reviewer recomputes them. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
